# Version Files Reference

All files that contain version numbers and must be updated during a release. This is the single source of truth — if a file is missing from this list, it will be missed during releases.

## Package JSON Files (9 total)

All use `"version": "X.Y.Z"` format.

| File | Package Name | Package Manager |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| `package.json` (root) | `mone` | pnpm |
| `src/mone-web/api/package.json` | `@mone/api` | pnpm |
| `src/mone-web/web/package.json` | `@mone/web` | pnpm |
| `src/admin-portal/api/package.json` | `mone-portal-api` | pnpm |
| `src/admin-portal/web/package.json` | `mone-portal-web` | pnpm |
| `src/landing/package.json` | `@mone/landing` | pnpm |
| `src/scheduler/package.json` | `@mone/scheduler` | pnpm |
| `src/shared/package.json` | `@mone/shared` | pnpm |
| `src/mobile/package.json` | `@mone/mobile` | **npm** (not pnpm!) |

### Update Commands

```bash
# pnpm workspace packages (8 files) — use node script:
node -e "
const fs = require('fs');
const files = [
  'package.json',
  'src/admin-portal/api/package.json',
  'src/admin-portal/web/package.json',
  'src/landing/package.json',
  'src/mone-web/api/package.json',
  'src/mone-web/web/package.json',
  'src/scheduler/package.json',
  'src/shared/package.json'
];
files.forEach(f => {
  const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8'));
  p.version = '<VERSION>';
  fs.writeFileSync(f, JSON.stringify(p, null, 2) + '\n');
});
console.log('Updated', files.length, 'files');
"

# Mobile (npm, separate) — MUST use npm, not pnpm:
cd src/mobile
npm version <VERSION> --no-git-tag-version
cd ../..
```

## iOS Version (Xcode project)

File: `src/mobile/ios/mobile.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`

Two occurrences of `MARKETING_VERSION` (Debug + Release build configurations):

```
MARKETING_VERSION = X.Y.Z;
```

Both must be updated. Search and replace all occurrences.

> Note: `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` stays at `1` — it is managed by CI.

## Mobile Version Constants

File: `src/mobile/src/config/version.ts`

```typescript
export const VERSION = 'X.Y.Z';
export const BUILD_HASH = '<current-git-short-hash>';
```

Update `VERSION` to the new version and `BUILD_HASH` to the current HEAD short hash:

```bash
git rev-parse --short HEAD
```

> Note: This file is normally auto-generated by `scripts/generate-version.js` during build, but for release we update it manually to ensure the committed version is correct.

## Files That Do NOT Need Manual Updates

| File | Reason |
|------|--------|
| `src/mobile/android/app/build.gradle` | `versionName` reads from `package.json` dynamically |
| `src/mobile/ios/mobile/Info.plist` | Uses `$(MARKETING_VERSION)` from pbxproj |
| `pnpm-lock.yaml` | Auto-updated by `pnpm install` |
| `src/mobile/package-lock.json` | Auto-updated by `npm version` |
| `wrangler.toml` files | No version field |

## Verification

After updating all files, run this scan to confirm no old version remains:

```powershell
$oldVersions = @("X.Y.Z-OLD")  # Add all old versions to check
$files = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File |
  Where-Object {
    $_.FullName -notlike "*node_modules*" -and
    $_.FullName -notlike "*dist*" -and
    $_.FullName -notlike "*.git*" -and
    $_.FullName -notlike "*pnpm-lock*" -and
    $_.FullName -notlike "*package-lock*" -and
    $_.FullName -notlike "*release-notes*" -and
    $_.FullName -notlike "*CHANGELOG*" -and
    $_.FullName -notlike "*ai-benchmark*" -and
    $_.Extension -match "\.(json|ts|tsx|js|pbxproj)$"
  }
$pattern = ($oldVersions | ForEach-Object { [regex]::Escape($_) }) -join "|"
$files | ForEach-Object {
  Select-String -Path $_.FullName -Pattern $pattern -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
} | Format-Table Path, LineNumber, Line -AutoSize
```

Empty output = all clear.
